title: AgentReadinessProvider
description: A provider-level aggregate that collects every agent-readiness signal observed for one API provider and rolls them up into an overall score.

provider.description: Canonical name of the API provider.

providerSlug.description: Lowercased, hyphenated slug used for cross-references.

signals.description: All agent-readiness signals observed for this provider.

overallScore.description: Mean of the numeric scores across all signals. Computed; not authoritative.

observedOn.description: Date the provider aggregate was assembled.

observer.description: Person or organisation that recorded the aggregate.

tags.description: Free-form tags grouping the provider (e.g. industry, integration pattern).
